features.s2: One platform for the whole knowledge lifecycle
features.s3: From document intake to Q&A to automated reports, KnowledgeAI turns scattered knowledge into your team's intelligence.
features.s5: Accurate answers grounded in your private knowledge base, with traceable citations you can click through. Streaming output in milliseconds.
features.s10: Multiple agents collaborate to plan, search, analyze and write, producing structured research reports automatically.
features.s13: Drag & drop PDF / Word / Markdown / web pages - automatically chunked and vectorized.
features.s16: RBAC permission model, shared KBs with audit trails, multi-tenant isolation.
features.s19: Q&A, API, storage and agent usage at a glance, visualized by day/week/month.
features.s22: 2FA, session management, data export - GDPR and PIPL compliant.
features.s24: Free / Pro / Enterprise plans with WeChat, Alipay and card payments.

pricing.s2: For personal use and small projects
pricing.s27: Start free and upgrade as your team grows. All plans include data isolation and GDPR compliance.

privacy.s5: We collect only the minimum data needed to provide the service: documents and knowledge base content you upload, Q&A and agent research records, account info (name, email), usage and billing records, and device/login info (IP, browser type).
privacy.s6: We do not collect sensitive personal information unrelated to the service (e.g. ID numbers, full bank card numbers). Payments are handled by third-party gateways (WeChat Pay / Alipay); we never store full payment credentials.
privacy.s8: Your data is used only to: provide KB building, Q&A and agent research; improve retrieval and generation quality; produce usage stats and invoices; protect account security and prevent fraud.
privacy.s9: Unless you explicitly enable "data for model training" in settings, your content is never used to train AI models. Even when enabled, data is desensitized.
privacy.s11: All data in transit uses TLS 1.3; at rest it is encrypted with AES-256. Multi-tenant data is isolated at the row level (tenant_id) so teams never see each other's data.
privacy.s12: We run regular security audits and penetration tests, and manage internal access on a least-privilege basis.
privacy.s14: Under GDPR Articles 15-22 and the PIPL, you have the right to access (a copy of your data), correct (fix inaccuracies), delete (request removal), restrict processing, portability, and object.
privacy.s15: You can export all data or request account deletion in Settings → Data privacy. Deletion requests are processed within 30 days.
privacy.s17: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember theme/language preferences. We do not use third-party ad-tracking cookies.
privacy.s18: You can clear cookies in your browser at any time, though some features may be affected.
privacy.s20: Account data is kept until deletion; conversations and call logs are kept 90 days by default (adjustable in settings); after deletion, all data is permanently removed within 30 days.

terms.s5: KnowledgeAI ("the Service") is an AI-powered knowledge management SaaS offering document upload, knowledge base building, Q&A, and agent research reports. By registering and using the Service you agree to these terms.
terms.s6: The Service is for lawful use only. You must be at least 18 (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction) to use it.
terms.s8: You agree not to: upload or spread illegal, infringing or harmful content; attempt unauthorized access to systems or data; abuse APIs or launch malicious attacks; interfere with the Service in any way; or reverse-engineer or resell the Service without permission.
terms.s9: You retain full rights to the content you upload and warrant it does not infringe third-party IP. We claim no ownership of your content.
terms.s11: Q&A and agent research use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); outputs are generated automatically by AI models from your knowledge base content.
terms.s12: AI-generated content may be inaccurate, incomplete or outdated. We do not guarantee its accuracy, completeness or suitability. Verify content before making important decisions; the Service is for reference only and is not professional advice (legal, medical, financial, etc.).
terms.s13: We are not liable for any direct or indirect loss caused by reliance on AI-generated content.
terms.s15: The Service's software, UI design, branding and source code are our intellectual property, protected by law. Do not copy, modify or distribute without written permission.
terms.s16: Documents you upload and content generated are yours. We process your content only as needed to provide the service and never transfer it to third parties.
terms.s18: We reserve the right to modify, suspend or terminate part or all of the service. Plan terms, pricing and features may change with prior notice.
terms.s19: You may delete your account at any time. If you violate these terms, we may restrict or terminate your account.
